title: Customer economics and concentration deserve review
management_question: Which customer relationships create value and where is dependency material?
rationale: 3 material signal(s) across CUS-01, CUS-02 support one management theme. Related signals are compressed without deleting their underlying evidence.
next_step: Review contribution, concentration and commercial context for the customers driving the evidence.
limitation: No causal or monetised opportunity conclusion is created by management-attention selection.
